visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at a bustling urban intersection under a bright sky. A man in a dark polo shirt and light trousers stands on the sidewalk, looking towards the street. A black SUV and several scooters navigate the crosswalk area, framed by high-rise residential buildings and a sign labeled 'JIU RUAN'. (2) The camera pans right, transitioning from the concrete pavement to a park setting. An individual wearing a helmet and a pink shirt rides an orange public sharing bicycle across a cobblestone path. Large tree trunks and lush green bushes populate the foreground and background. (3) The pan continues to reveal a person with gray hair sitting on the grass behind a neatly trimmed hedge. In the background, a blue truck drives past a pedestrian overpass. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, casting clear shadows on the ground. (4) The camera focuses on a tranquil garden area with a pink flowering tree and manicured topiary. Transparent white text '迴 旋 的 詩' appears at the bottom left. The background features more apartment complexes and the blue and white structure of the pedestrian bridge. (5) The camera pans back to the left, capturing the bicyclist again before returning to the initial street view. A white delivery truck with green markings and a yellow car pass through the intersection under a red traffic light.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the dense, continuous hum of urban traffic. The sounds of car engines idling and accelerating are prominent, layered with the high-pitched buzz of scooters passing by. Faint bird chirping is intermittently audible beneath the roar of internal combustion engines. (2) A transition occurs as the traffic noise slightly recedes into the background floor and a melodic, sentimental background music track enters. The music features soft, high-register piano notes with synthesized mallet-like textures, creating a poetic and calm atmosphere. No human speech is recorded. (3) The music continues to play as the primary auditory layer, maintaining a slow to moderate tempo with very few rhythmic transients. Background environmental sounds of the city remain as a stable, low-level acoustic floor. (4) The music track fades out, and the audio returns to the dominant sounds of the intersection, characterized by the low-frequency rumble of a large vehicle engine and the splashing air-flow sounds of cars driving by.
